_readme: Roads every Hong Kong driver knows the public-light-bus status of, with the status the cut-off build gave them when this list was verified (2026-09-22), so a TD data change on one of them is noticed by `node scripts/audit-cutoff-notices.mjs`.

status: `banned` = a closing PLB row sits on the street; `cutoff` = no closing row on it, but it lies in a cut-off area; `open` = neither. `timed` = rows exist but none closes (part-time / conditional).

Verified against published practice, not sign points: the Yuen Long-Jordan red minibus runs Castle Peak Road and joins Tsuen Wan Road only at Tai Chung Road (16seats r_kn68; zh.wikipedia 荃灣路); the Aberdeen red minibuses reach Kowloon by Pok Fu Lam Road and the Western Harbour Crossing (16seats r_kh70/r_kh71); the Kwun Tong-Sha Tin service uses Lion Rock Tunnel (16seats r_kn89); red minibuses may use only the Eastern Harbour Crossing-Chai Wan Road section of the Island Eastern Corridor, and TD's 2021 notice #62817 keeps every IEC slip road banned (zh.wikipedia 東區走廊); Kwun Tong Bypass is open to them 1000-0100 only (zh.wikipedia 觀塘繞道).
